notes: Modified-cash-basis school district (FY ends 2025-08-31), governmental funds only, no business-type funds (school nutrition is reported as a governmental fund here). Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4, continuation of p3). Roll-forward 837,634.81 + 3,533,337.75 - 3,354,280.65 = 1,016,691.91 ties. Interfund transfers (General out 153,119.64 = to School Nutrition 95,000 + to Activities 58,119.64) net to zero in the total column through the Reclassification column, so top-level transfers_in/out are null; the transfer is in detail as other financing (General -, Activities and School Nutrition +). Statement receipt lines 'Local receipts', 'County receipts', 'Activities', 'Interest' and 'Other' split using the General (p6), QCPU (p11), Activities (p8), School Nutrition (p9) and Special Building (p10) fund schedules; the splits sum to the printed lines (property 1,565,397.01 and carline 12,370.85 also agree with Statement of Activities p2). Interest on taxes (3,450.30) is categorized as property tax per rules although the statement shows it in Interest. 'Support services' 1,098,704.81 split into support services 976,575.60 and student transportation 122,129.21 using the Statement of Activities p2 and Exhibit N p16. QCPU fund disbursements 111,684.32 appear only in the total column; itemized from p11 (principal 106,068.14, interest 4,566.18, fees 1,050.00). State/federal program lines categorized as instruction with review. Balance sheet is the Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1). Detail: General Fund receipts from the budget schedule p6; General Fund spending by object from Exhibit N (pp12-17), which supersedes the function-only General Fund disbursement schedule p7 (not entered, no double counting); transfers (912, 913) are inside the printed Total disbursements 3,065,541.98 and recorded as signed other financing with includes on the total; Exhibit N 5000 Debt payments (actual 0) and 'Other expenditures' (actual 0) and zero-actual object lines omitted; the 'Total state programs' printed again under Debt payments is a mislabel of the debt total (0 actual). Activities Fund recorded account by account from p18 (receipts 163,851.16 include 14,951.25 donations not separable by account; general fund support recorded as other financing per account, total 58,119.64); the one-line activities budget schedule p8 left out, and the 2024 comparative per-account schedule (p19) ignored. School Nutrition detail (p9): printed revenue total 160,307.58 includes the 95,000 transfer (includes other financing). Summary budget comparison p5 (fund totals only) not entered.
